text: おちている　どうぐも　もらえるよ！

structure.jp: おちている　どうぐも
structure.en: the items lying on the ground, too

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている here shows the state left after something happened: it fell and is still lying there. It describes the items after it. おちている　どうぐ = 'items that are lying on the ground'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing もらう to もらえる adds the meaning 'can'. もらえる = 'you can get them'.
